parse.title: Mysterious Sphere
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-Sphere.png}} {{E|Mysterious Sphere}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 3]]. ==Options== {{Frame|Open Sphere}} {{TS|negative||Fight.}} {{TS|positive||Reward: }} {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} {{TS|positive||[[Relic]].}} * The player enters combat with the 2 {{M|Orb Walker|Orb Walkers}}. In addition to the {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], the combat rewards also yield 45-55 [[Gold]], a normal card reward, and potentially a [[Potion]] just like a normal combat.
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. ==Dialogue==
Jutting from the chaotic terrain around you, a bony sphere surrounds a mysterious glowing object within.
While you are curious what lies inside, you notice some sentries keeping an eye on it.
{{Frame|Open Sphere}}
As soon as you strike the sphere, the sentries spring to life around you!


{{Frame|Fight}}

The sphere visually breaks open and the player enters combat with the 2 {{M|Orb Walker|Orb Walkers}}.
{{Frame|Leave}}
No need to be greedy.
==Notes== * Although the fight can be quite dangerous and offers a [[Relic]] reward, it does not count as an [[Elite]] combat for the sake of {{R|Preserved Insect}}, {{R|Sling of Courage}}, {{R|Black Star}}, and {{R|Slaver's Collar}}. ==Gallery== {| style="float:left; margin:0 0 10px 10px;" | [[File:SphereClosed.png|200px|thumb|The closed sphere.]] | [[File:SphereOpen.png|200px|thumb|The opened sphere.]] |} {{Clear}} ==Update History== * '''Weekly Patch 46: Adrenaline''' ** The Mysterious Sphere event in Act 3 now uses the Double Orb Walker combat. (was Orb Walker and 2 Shapes) * '''Weekly Patch 31: Custom Mode''' ** Clarified relic rarity on Mysterious Sphere event. * '''Weekly Patch 25: Building Blocks''' ** Mysterious Sphere event enemies now attack in the correct order * '''Weekly Patch 8: Ooh Shiny!''' ** Minor wording improvements for the Mysterious Sphere event. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
